grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: Meal Planning for a Busy Week
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于饮食与日常选择的。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。判断题选择 True、False 或 Not Given。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage:
A) Li Wei is a busy office worker in Shanghai. He often eats fast food because he has much work. But he knows he should eat more vegetables. Last week, he made a meal plan for the first time. He wrote a shopping list and bought a few carrots, a little rice, and some chicken. He also bought many eggs because they are cheap and easy to cook.

B) On Monday, Li Wei cooked chicken with carrots. He used a little oil and a few spices. The food was good, but he put too much salt. He should not use much salt because it is not healthy. On Tuesday, he made egg fried rice. He used two eggs and a little rice. He had a few minutes to eat, so he ate quickly. On Wednesday, he was very busy and ate fast food again. He felt tired after eating it.

C) On Thursday, Li Wei cooked vegetables and rice. He did not use much oil. He felt good after the meal. He thinks he should plan his meals every week. He should not buy too much food because it can go bad. He also should not eat too many sweets. Now he has a few simple recipes and a little more energy. He says, 'I should cook more often. It is not difficult.'

questions.prompt: Why does Li Wei often eat fast food?
options: Because he does not like vegetables.
questions.explanation: 短文第一段明确说“He often eats fast food because he has much work.”，所以选A。
questions.evidence: He often eats fast food because he has much work.

questions.prompt: What did Li Wei buy on his shopping list?
options: a few carrots, a little rice, and some chicken
many eggs and a little rice
a few carrots and many eggs
some chicken and a little oil
answers: a few carrots, a little rice, and some chicken
questions.explanation: 第一段说“He wrote a shopping list and bought a few carrots, a little rice, and some chicken.”，所以选A。
questions.evidence: He wrote a shopping list and bought a few carrots, a little rice, and some chicken.

questions.prompt: What did Li Wei put too much of when cooking on Monday?
questions.explanation: 第二段说“he put too much salt”，所以答案是salt。

questions.prompt: Why does Li Wei think he should not buy too much food?
options: Because he does not like it.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“He should not buy too much food because it can go bad.”，所以选B。
questions.evidence: He should not buy too much food because it can go bad.

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei say about cooking?
questions.explanation: 第三段最后说“It is not difficult.”，所以选B。

questions.prompt: Li Wei ate fast food on Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 第二段说“On Wednesday, he was very busy and ate fast food again.”，所以是True。
questions.evidence: On Wednesday, he was very busy and ate fast food again.

questions.prompt: Li Wei used a lot of oil on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“He did not use much oil.”，与“a lot of oil”矛盾，所以是False。
questions.evidence: He did not use much oil.

questions.prompt: Li Wei's family likes his cooking.
questions.explanation: 短文中没有提到他的家人是否喜欢他的烹饪，所以是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 短文中没有提到他的家人是否喜欢他的烹饪。

questions.prompt: Li Wei bought ______ eggs because they are cheap and easy to cook. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 第一段说“He also bought many eggs because they are cheap and easy to cook.”，所以填many。
questions.evidence: He also bought many eggs because they are cheap and easy to cook.

questions.prompt: On Tuesday, Li Wei used ______ eggs and a little rice. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 第二段说“He used two eggs and a little rice.”，所以填two。
questions.evidence: He used two eggs and a little rice.

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few; 数量表达; should / should not
grammar.explanation: much 用于不可数名词（如 work, salt, oil），many 用于可数名词复数（如 eggs, carrots）。a little 用于不可数名词，表示“一点”；a few 用于可数名词复数，表示“几个”。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: He should not use much salt because it is not healthy.

questions.prompt: There are ______ apples on the table. (many / much)
questions.explanation: apples 是可数名词复数，所以用 many。

questions.prompt: I have ______ water in my bottle. (a few / a little)
questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，所以用 a little。

questions.prompt: You ______ eat more fruit. It is good for you. (should / should not)
questions.explanation: 吃水果是好的，所以用 should。

questions.prompt: He ______ eat too much candy. (should / should not)
questions.explanation: 吃太多糖不好，所以用 should not。
